about: RAG retrieval evaluation set (scripts/eval_rag.py, tests/test_rag_eval.py). Each case: the user question as typed in chat; `sources` = acceptable source ids (a hit = any of them retrieved); `terms` = optional strings of which at least one must appear in the packed passages; `expect_empty` = nothing in the corpus answers it, so retrieval should return no passages. Pathway is inferred exactly as chat does (rag_service.infer_pathway).
